name: I-HIV
tagline: Hlola, phatha, awubonakali. Phila impilo egcwele.

what_is_it.heading: I-HIV ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: I-HIV imele i-Human Immunodeficiency Virus. Ihlasela isimiso sokuzivikela somzimba - ikakhulukazi uhlobo lwamangqamuzana amhlophe egazi abizwa ngokuthi i-CD4 cell.
paragraphs: Ngaphandle kokwelashwa, i-HIV ingawenza buthaka amasosha omzimba ngokuhamba kweminyaka kuze kube yilapho umzimba ungakwazi ukulwa nezifo. Leso sigaba esithuthukile sibizwa nge-AIDS. Ngokwelashwa, i-HIV ihlala ilawulekile, amasosha omzimba ahlala eqinile, futhi abantu baphila ukuphila okugcwele, okujwayelekile.

I-HIV ayisesona isigwebo sentambo. ENingizimu Afrika, ukwelashwa kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni, futhi abantu abaningi abathola imishanguzo bangalindela ukuphila isikhathi eside njenganoma ubani omunye.

items.headline: 7.8 million
items.body: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaphila ne-HIV - ngaphezu kwanoma yiliphi izwe emhlabeni.

items.headline: Mahhala
items.body: Ukwelashwa kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni. Ayikho i-medical aid edingekayo.

items.headline: U = U
items.body: Okungabonakali kufana nokungadluliseki. Ekwelashweni okusebenzayo awukwazi ukudlulisela i-HIV.

items.headline: Izingane ezingenalo i-HIV
items.body: Abesifazane abakhulelwe abathola imishanguzo bangaba nezingane ezingenayo i-HIV. I-PMTCT iyasebenza.

pull_quote.text: Ukuhlola ukuphela kwendlela yokwazi isimo sakho. Izimpawu azikwazi ukukutshela. Abantu abaningi abane-HIV bazizwa bephilile ngokuphelele iminyaka.

signs.heading: Ongase ukuqaphele
signs.lede: I-HIV ivame ukungabi nazimpawu nhlobo iminyaka. Yilokhu okwenza kube yingozi - futhi kungani ukuhlola kubaluleke ngaphezu kokulinda ukuzizwa ugula.

items.title: Izimpawu zokuqala (amaviki angu-2-4 ngemva kokuchayeka)
items.description: Umkhuhlane, umphimbo obuhlungu, izindlala ezivuvukele entanyeni noma emakhwapheni, ukukhathala, ukuqubuka, ubuhlungu bomzimba. Ngokuvamile uzizwa njengomkhuhlane futhi uzihambela wodwa.

items.title: Izimpawu zakamuva (ngaphandle kokwelashwa)
items.description: Ukutheleleka njalo, ukuncipha kwesisindo ngendlela engachazeki, isifo sohudo esibeleselayo, ukujuluka ebusuku, amabala amhlophe emlonyeni, ukuqubuka kwesikhumba okungapholi.

items.title: Iqiniso eliqinile
items.description: Awukwazi ukubona ukuthi une-HIV ngendlela ozizwa ngayo. Hlola. Iyashesha, imahhala, futhi iyimfihlo.

spreads.heading: Yini esakaza i-HIV - nokuthi yini engayisabalalisi
yes: Ucansi olungavikelekile (esithweni sangasese sangasese, sangemuva, noma somlomo)
Umama ukuya enganeni ngesikhathi sokuzalwa noma encelisa (kuvinjelwa ngokwelashwa)
Ukuthintana kwegazi kuya egazini ngenxeba elivulekile
no: Ukwabelana ngokudla, iziphuzo, amapuleti, noma okokudla
Izindlu zangasese, amachibi okubhukuda, noma amashawa

items.myth: Uma une-HIV, awukwazi ukuba nempilo evamile.
items.fact: Ekwelashweni, abantu abane-HIV baphila isikhathi eside njenganoma ubani omunye, basebenze, bakhulise imindeni, futhi bahambe ngokukhululeka.

items.myth: Ungathola i-HIV ngokuhlanganyela ingilazi noma ngokuqabula.
items.fact: I-HIV ayisakazwa ngamathe, umjuluko, noma ukuthintana nje. Uketshezi oluthile kuphela oluthwala igciwane.
Uma esetshenziswa ngendlela efanele ngaso sonke isikhathi, amakhondomu asebenza kahle kakhulu ekuvimbeleni i-HIV.

items.myth: Abazali abane-HIV abakwazi ukuba nezingane ezingenayo i-HIV.
items.fact: Ngohlelo lwe-PMTCT, cishe yonke ingane ingazalwa ingenayo i-HIV, ngisho noma oyedwa noma bobabili abazali bene-HIV.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokuzivikela
prevention.lede: INingizimu Afrika inezinhlelo eziqinile zokuvikela i-HIV emhlabeni. Iningi likhululekile. Nakhu okusebenzayo.

items.title: Amakhondomu
items.description: Sebenzisa eyodwa njalo. Itholakala mahhala emitholampilo, emakhemisi, ngisho nakumagaraji kaphethiloli. Amakhondomu abesifazane nawo amahhala.

items.title: I-PrEP
items.description: Iphilisi lansuku zonke elivimbela i-HIV. Isebenza kahle kakhulu. Itholakala mahhala emitholampilo kubantu abasengozini enkulu.

items.title: I-PEP (phakathi kwamahora angu-72)
items.description: Uma ucabanga ukuthi usanda kudalulwa - fika emtholampilo kungakapheli amahora angama-72. Amaphilisi ezimo eziphuthumayo angavimba i-HIV ukuthi ibambe.

items.title: Yazi isimo sakho
items.description: Hlola njalo ezinyangeni ezi-6-12 uma uya ocansini. Izithandani zingahlola ndawonye. Imiphumela emizuzwini eyi-15.

items.title: Uma ucabanga ukuthi usanda kuvezwa
items.description: Yiya emtholampilo noma egumbini lezimo eziphuthumayo engakapheli amahora angama-72 ucele i-PEP. Ngokushesha kuba ngcono - phakathi namahora angu-24 kungcono kakhulu.

items.title: Uma ungazange uhlolwe ngonyaka odlule
items.description: Hlola. Kumahhala, kuyashesha, futhi kuyimfihlo. Akukho ukuqokwa okudingekayo emitholampilo eminingi. Thatha umlingani uma ungakwazi.

items.title: Uma uthola ukuthi unayo
items.description: Qala ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Kumahhala. Ukwelashwa kusebenza kangcono uma kuqalwa kusenesikhathi - akukho nzuzo ekulindeni.

items.title: Uma udla imishanguzo
items.description: Thatha imithi yakho nsuku zonke, ngesikhathi esifanayo. Ungalokothi weqe. Uma imiphumela engemihle ikukhathaza, khuluma nomtholampilo wakho.

items.title: Uma ukhulelwe
items.description: Zihlole kusenesikhathi. Uma une-positive, uhlelo lwe-PMTCT cishe njalo luvimbela ukusuleleka enganeni.

get_help.heading: Ubiza bani, uyephi
get_help.lede: Akudingeki ukuba ucabange lokhu uwedwa. Lawa masevisi amahhala, ayimfihlo, futhi ayatholakala manje.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka ngokuhlolelwa i-HIV mahhala kanye nokwelashwa
helplines.meta: Akukho ukuqokwa · alukho usizo lwezokwelapha oludingekayo · Umazisi uyasiza
